_about: Worked M8 scenario (docs/m8_decision_pipeline.md §8). Tenant: Harbour Coffee Roasters. Entity names and numbers are illustrative, shaped like the recorded brief; at run time every id comes from the tenant graph. 'expected' blocks are the author's hypothesis for the eval, NOT Jev output - Jev has not been called (openrouter.ai unreachable from the build container).

body.summary: Fire reported at the Felixstowe bonded warehouse (unit 4). Fire service on site. Operator says green coffee stock in bays C-F may be affected; no access until further notice.

expert_relevance._jev: one noul per approved expert role; the orchestrator does not pick

asks.q: What stock is held at FXT-BONDED-4, by lot and origin, and is any of it held elsewhere?
How many days of roasting does on-site green stock cover, by blend?
Which inbound containers are routed to FXT-BONDED-4 in the next 21 days?
Bays C-F held the Brazil and Colombia lots behind House Espresso. Which importers hold UK spot stock of comparable lots, and at what lead time?
Which wholesale customers take House Espresso, with fill-rate penalty terms?

evidence_sufficient._jev: noul after each round; plus a hard cap of 4 rounds

event.summary: Fire at Felixstowe bonded warehouse unit 4; bays C-F (green coffee) possibly affected; no access.

evidence.claim: Bays C-F hold 38 t of green coffee: Brazil Cerrado lot BR-114 (19 t) and Colombia Huila lot CO-207 (19 t). No other site holds these lots.
A second bonded store at Tilbury (TIL-BONDED-1) is an existing contracted site with roughly 60 pallet spaces free.
On-site green stock covers House Espresso for 6 roasting days at current demand.
Container MSKU-ILLUSTRATIVE (Ethiopia Guji, 19 t) is due to discharge at Felixstowe on 2026-10-19 for delivery to FXT-BONDED-4.
Importer IMP-03 holds UK spot stock of a comparable Brazil lot, 2-3 day delivery, about 18% over contract price.
Three wholesale accounts take House Espresso; two have fill-rate penalties (the last such event cost about £18k).

analysis.impact_summary: If bays C-F are lost, House Espresso stops after 6 roasting days; 38 t of green coffee at risk; the inbound Guji container has nowhere to go on 10-19.

comms.subject: Unit 4 fire - stock status and access
comms.body: Please confirm as soon as you can which of bays C-F are affected (lots BR-114, CO-207), and whether customs control of the bonded stock is maintained. We are diverting inbound container SHP-5512 away from unit 4.

comms.subject: Divert SHP-5512 to Tilbury bonded store
comms.body: Please re-book delivery of SHP-5512 from FXT-BONDED-4 to TIL-BONDED-1 under bond on discharge (ETA 19 Oct).

comms.subject: Spot purchase: Brazil, 19 t
comms.body: Requesting a firm offer and allocation hold on 19 t comparable Brazil spot, delivery to Ipswich within 3 days.

comms.subject: House Espresso supply - early notice
comms.body: A fire at our bonded warehouse may affect House Espresso. Your orders for the next 6 days are covered; we will confirm the plan for the following weeks by Monday.

comms.subject: Notification of potential loss - Felixstowe
comms.body: Notifying a potential stock loss of up to 38 t green coffee at FXT-BONDED-4, cause fire, 17 Oct 2026.

G1.instructions: How do we keep House Espresso supplied beyond the 6 days of on-site cover? Choose what an experienced supply chain operator would do now. Escalate on weak signals rather than anchoring on a first estimate; secure scarce capacity before others take it; prefer reversible actions while uncertainty is high; prefer pre-qualified alternatives over new ones.

criteria.G1_a_reblend: Reblend House Espresso from on-site and Tilbury stock. Reversible, effective in 24h, low cost; risk: taste change.
criteria.G1_b_spot_buy: Buy 19 t comparable Brazil spot from IMP-03 now. Irreversible, effective in 72h, about 18% premium; risk: stock may be undamaged.
criteria.G1_c_allocate: Allocate remaining House Espresso to penalty-bearing accounts first. Reversible, effective in 2h; cost: lost sales on WH-03.
criteria.G1_d_wait: Wait for the operator's damage assessment before acting. No cost now; risk: spot stock taken by others, cover runs down.

priority.instructions: How long can this event's decisions wait for a human? Urgency, not stakes.
criteria: low: impact is more than a week away or small; nothing gets worse by waiting a day
medium: impact within days; waiting a few hours for a person costs little
high: impact within 24-48h; a person should decide today; hours of delay narrow the options
critical: options are disappearing within hours - physical loss in progress, capacity others will take, perishable stock; waiting for approval makes the decision moot

policy.then_approve: top option of each choice group; each noul with P(yes) >= 0.6
policy.else: all options to the human queue with Jev probabilities shown
